title: DeviceChain Alert payload
description: The payload of a device event whose eventType is Alert. Every entry is one alert a device wants a person or a rule to see. One event may carry at most 256 entries.

entries.description: The alerts. A payload with no entries, or with an alert placed directly under payload instead of in entries, is refused.

type.description: The classifier that notification policies, rules and console filters route on. An entry with an empty or missing type is refused.

level.description: Severity, a bare JSON integer (a quoted level fails the whole message). Omitted, it is 0.

source.description: What on the device raised the alert.

occurredTime.description: This alert's own instant, RFC 3339. Omitted, the alert takes the envelope's occurredTime. Refused under the same rules as the envelope's.
